Vendor / bamboohr pricing

BambooHR pricing in 2026

BambooHR is quote-only. Buying-committee evidence puts Core at ~$6 PEPM, Pro at ~$10 PEPM, and the Payroll add-on at ~$6 PEPM. Under 25 employees the rate is banded as a flat monthly fee rather than strict PEPM. A 100-employee Pro + Payroll + Performance stack typically lands at $16-$20 PEPM all-in.

What the buying committee actually pays

BambooHR rarely waives the per-module add-on. SSO upgrade is bundled with Pro, not sold separately. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What is the PEPM difference between Core and Pro?

Pro adds Performance, Time Tracking integration, and Advanced Reporting on top of Core. The PEPM step is roughly $4 in observed quotes ($6 to $10).

Which features are paid add-ons?

Payroll (add-on, ~$6 PEPM), Benefits Administration (add-on, ~$5 PEPM), Performance (bundled with Pro), Time Tracking (add-on, ~$3 PEPM). The base directory, org chart, and ATS are included in Core.

Is pricing flat-banded under 25 employees?

Yes. BambooHR bands sub-25 deployments into a flat monthly Core or Pro fee rather than strict PEPM. The transition to PEPM happens at 25.

What is the typical onboarding fee?

$0 to $4,500 depending on tier and module count. BambooHR frequently waives implementation in exchange for annual upfront payment.

How is SSO priced?

SAML SSO is bundled with Pro at no separate upcharge. Core does not include SSO.
